Title: Generally Available: Azure Site Recovery for Shared Disk

Body.Content:
We are excited to announce the General Availability of Azure Site Recovery for Shared Disk feature, which enables you to protect, monitor, recover, and re-protect your workloads running on Windows Server Failover Clusters (WSFC) on Azure VMs with Shared Disk. 


Now you can use the benefits of Shared Disk for your mission-critical applications such as SQL FCI, SAP ASCS, Scale-out File Servers, etc., while ensuring business continuity and disaster recovery with Azure Site Recovery. 


Salient Features: 

  • OS Support: Windows Server 2016 and later.  

  • Nodes: Up to 4 nodes per cluster. 

  • Shared Disks: Any number of shared disks can be attached to the cluster.  

  • High Churn and PowerShell Support 

Learn more.
